meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多来源深度调研自动整理成带引用的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需针对复杂问题多方位查证并输出有证据的总结
copy.tagline_en: Automatically turn multi-source research into cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need multi-source research and evidence-backed summaries

howto.what: 装上后,当你要它做深度研究时,Claude 会先提出最终交付物(默认 PDF+DOCX),再派出多组并行搜索,覆盖代码、网页、官方文档和开源仓库;实时记录,追查线索,用运行代码验证有争议的说法,最后交出每句带引用或证据、且通过质检的报告。
howto.when: 只在你说出「ulw-research」「ultradebate」等明确研究指令,或直接要求做深度研究、超精确调查时触发,任何语言都算。普通提问、调试或收集实现背景时不会激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深度调研一下量子计算的最新进展,要带引用。
say.note: 会触发全程深挖,输出每句带引用的报告。

say.text: 对 RAG 技术做 hyperdebate 研究,正反双方都要有证据。
say.note: 会安排至少两个攻防视角逐条质疑证据。

say.text: 查一下这个项目的 ulw-research:对比官方文档和代码里的实际实现。
say.note: 会并行派出多组搜索并交叉验证,产出对照材料。

howto.what_en: On research requests, Claude proposes deliverables first, runs parallel explorer/librarian swarms across code, web, docs, OSS, journals live, chases leads, runs code to verify claims, then delivers a cited synthesis gated by visual QA.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit research demands: ulw-research, ultradebate/hyperdebate, or a request for deep research in any language. Casual questions, debugging, or context-gathering never fire it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to deep-dive latest quantum computing progress, cited.
say_en.note: Triggers full deep-dive and a cited report.

say_en.text: Run a hyperdebate on RAG: both sides must back claims with evidence.
say_en.note: Runs at least two attacker perspectives on contested claims.

say_en.text: ulw-research this repo: compare official docs vs actual code implementation.
say_en.note: Fans out parallel searches and cross-checks for a comparison.
